text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the removal of an on-street accessible loading zone located on the west side of Woodmount Avenue, between a point 12 metres north of Sammon Avenue and a point 6.5 metres further north.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible loading zone operating at all times on the west side of Woodmount Avenue, between a point 12 metres north of Sammon Avenue and a point 6.5 metres further north.
